subject.title: Echo contamination: stripInboundMetadata not called in outbound delivery pipeline

question: Should this issue be resolved by refreshing and landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50520, superseded by broader shared sanitizer work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100791, or held for the trusted inbound-decoration contract tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95279?
rationale: Current main still has the leak, but multiple open candidate fixes touch different security/message-delivery boundaries, so ClawSweeper should not choose or open another fix path unilaterally.

options.title: Refresh the narrow outbound fix
options.body: Resolve the conflicts in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50520 and review its leading-metadata outbound-boundary tests as the canonical fix for this issue.

options.title: Supersede with shared sanitizer work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100791 only if maintainers accept the shared assistant-visible sanitizer boundary as covering this issue without directive-parsing regressions.

options.title: Wait for trusted decoration contract
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95279 if maintainers want to avoid heuristic metadata stripping before adding a trusted out-of-band decoration contract.

recommendation.title: Refresh the narrow outbound fix
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50520 and review its leading-metadata outbound-boundary tests as the canonical fix for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Ayaan has recent focused history in the inbound metadata sanitizer and delivery-hint stripping code that this decision depends on.
